messages:
priya: Heads-up - CS reporting a spike of 401s from our SCIM webhook to Okta for tenant acme-corp starting ~02:15 UTC. No obvious deploys at that time.

julian: Can you paste the error from the provisioner?

priya:
```
2026-03-25T02:16:12Z WARN scim/handler.go:78 auth failed: oauth2: invalid_token - introspect: token_kid_mismatch
tenant=acme-corp req=42b7a
```

morgan: "token_kid_mismatch" is interesting - implies the introspection token was signed with a kid we don't have in our JWKS cache. Did IdP rotate its client JWKs?

priya: Okta tenant reported a keys.rotate event at 02:10 UTC in their admin logs. They also mentioned a short-lived rotation where both old and new keys were served for ~3m.

julian: Our OIDC client caches the provider JWKS for 10m and validates kid strictly. If a client credential rotation left us without the new kid, introspection will fail. Should be able to fetch new JWKS on 401 but looks like our backoff prevents immediate refresh.

sec-bot: automated note: alert triggered `scim.401.rate > 5m` -> channel notified.

morgan: quick mitigation: force JWKS refresh in the provisioner and restart the pods. Also temporarily disable kid-strict enforcement to accept tokens signed by keys present in metadata if we have a matching public key. Risk: loosens validation; only do during window.

julian: I pushed a hotfix to the provisioner to call provider's /jwks_uri on 401 without backoff and to log incoming kid values for audit. Deploying to canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/provisioner v1.15.2 (commit b7c8d9) - 2026-03-25T02:43:01Z

priya: Canary shows success for acme-corp requests and 401s dropped to baseline. Notifying CS.

morgan: post-incident actions: 1) add JWKS rotation test to our SSO integration test harness (simulate JWKs rotate and overlapping keys), 2) extend runbook to include immediate JWKS refresh on token_kid_mismatch, 3) audit logs: enumerate all 401s with token_kid_mismatch between 02:05-02:20 UTC.

julian: Also check RBAC/audit trail: did any IAM or rolebinding changes coincide? I queried k8s audit and nothing changed in that timeframe. Looks like pure upstream rotate.

priya: I pulled CloudTrail + introspect logs and matched 31 failed introspects across 7 tenants; 5 were high priority: acme-corp, beta-retail, zenpay, orbit-inc, sysops-lite. I triggered backfills for those where membership changes were pending.

sre-oncall: created ticket SEC-2026-042 for vuln/mitigation tracking. Add severity = P2 because impact limited and short lived.

morgan: note for compliance: record the IdP rotation event and our accept/response timeline in the audit log. Add mapping between incoming kid values and tenant ids. We should also add a dashboard tile showing token_kid_mismatch occurrences per-tenant.

julian: rolling this into the scheduled postmortem doc. Also PR to change default behavior: immediate JWKS fetch on first introspect 401 and better metric tagging.

priya: CS notified and we confirmed no user-facing data loss. Closing slack thread once postmortem doc is up. Thanks all. :wave:
